piece.body:
What a long day. I spent most of my day coding, even at Tech I suppose I didn't do my work. I feel a little useless.
I have this horrible pit in my stomach, and I don't know why. I feel like I should be doing something, but I don't know what. I feel like I'm wasting my time, but I don't know what to do with it. Sure, my schoolwork, but I'm not. I am so failing. What am I doing with my life? Seriously, I sit around most days and do nothing, the time all runs away, I'm always stuck in place worrying abut how to spend the time, by the time im finished time has already moved on.
ANYWAYS, time for a new topic: XML!
I haven't really touched on it much at all, but the idea and concept of XML is so interesting, the fact it's really nothing until you make it something, how cool! Sadly, I am no master coder, and like in many of my mishaps.. I use AI to aid me.
I know it's something so heavily debated on, but I don't see an issue.. I think it's so useful, and an amazing tool when used in moderation, especially in coding. in my use case.. Javascript is a language I don't know, and I don't want to learn (yet), so I use AI to help me. Sorry-not-sorry?
So much fun, will impliment a tag that works for emojis.
